page.overview:
Who is Imreann?

Imreann is a character in Final Fantasy XVI. He is the high priest of the Crystalline Orthodox and the de facto leader of the Iron Kingdom. In his religious fanaticism, he propagates cruel practices of subjugation of Bearers and all magick-users, human sacrifice, and aggression toward nations that do not follow the dogma of the Crystalline Orthodox that posits that the Mothercrystals themselves are deities.

Imreann was born in the year of the realm 820 to the previous high priest of Crystalline Orthodox, and was raised as a successor for this role. He eventually takes over the role, and though the kingdom does have a royal family, the high priest is the effective ruler of the kingdom as the leader of the state faith. Imreann led the worship of the kingdom's own Mothercrystal, Drake's Breath on the volcanic Mount Drustanus, sacrificing Bearers kidnapped from other lands on its altar and, presumably, discovered among the kingdom's own populace.

After Iron Kingdom's raid to Rosaria after the Night of Flames saw the duchy's archduke and heir to the throne killed, many kidnapped women and girls came to reside in the Iron Isles and Imreann's purview. Jill Warrick was one of these girls kidnapped from Rosalith Castle, and in the year 861, Imreann tried to forge Jill to become his "nightly attendant"; Shiva awoke within her, and Imreann dropped his initial plan with Jill, forcing her to fight for the Ironblood as their weapon of mass destruction instead.

In 873, Imreann deployed Jill/Shiva to the Battle of Nysa where she faced off against the Dhalmekian Republic and Titan. She disappeared during the battle, and Imreann never learned what happened to her until Jill returned to the Iron Kingdom five years later to exact her revenge.
